#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

DEST="backup-srv:/srv/nightly"
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

# Run relative to this script so cron's working directory does not matter.
SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")" && pwd)
cd "$SCRIPT_DIR"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST/"

arguments.command:
set -eu
sh -n backup.sh
mock_dir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$mock_dir" "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"' EXIT
cat >"$mock_dir/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$SCP_ARGS_FILE"
EOF
chmod +x "$mock_dir/scp"
export SCP_ARGS_FILE="$mock_dir/args"
PATH="$mock_dir:$PATH" ./backup.sh
tar -tzf "logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
printf '%s\n' '--- scp arguments ---'
cat "$SCP_ARGS_FILE"
